title: Sliced Wasserstein Sketches with Error Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.20788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compact representations that support geometrically meaningful comparisons are valuable for learning from probability distributions. We study optimal, free-weight $M$-atom quantization of one-dimensional probability measures in quadratic Wasserstein distance and extend it to higher dimensions via slicing. Using $L$ shared projections yields a sketch with $O(LM)$ comparison time. Our main result is an exact decomposition of squared distance error into residual and partition-mismatch terms, yielding computable certificates for arbitrary centroid sketches. For optimal sketches, a finite $(2+\delta)$ moment for some $\delta>0$ guarantees $O(M^{-1})$ error in the finite-direction sliced distance, while equal-mass sketches can converge more slowly. Each slice preserves its mean, while storing residual energies enables covariance recovery from sufficiently many generic directions. Experiments on document, point-cloud, and flow-cytometry benchmar

translated_title: 带误差证书的切片 Wasserstein 草图表示
translated_abstract: 支持几何上有意义比较的紧凑表示，对于从概率分布中学习非常有价值。我们研究了在二次 Wasserstein 距离下，一维概率测度的最优、自由权重的 M 原子量化问题，并通过切片方法将其推广到更高维度。使用 L 个共享投影可以得到比较时间为 O(LM) 的草图表示。我们的主要结果是将平方距离误差精确分解为残差项与划分失配项之和，从而为任意质心草图提供可计算的误差证书。对于最优草图，只要存在某个 δ>0 使得 (2+δ) 阶矩有限，即可保证有限方向切片距离下 O(M^{-1}) 的误差；而等质量草图的收敛速度可能更慢。每个切片均保持其均值，同时通过存储残差能量，可以从足够多的一般性方向恢复协方差。在文档、点云和流式细胞术基准数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于切片 Wasserstein 距离的紧凑草图表示方法，通过将平方距离误差精确分解为残差与划分失配两项，为任意质心草图提供可计算的误差证书，并证明最优草图在温和矩条件下可达到 O(M^{-1}) 的误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes compact sliced Wasserstein sketches with computable error certificates via an exact decomposition of squared distance error into residual and partition-mismatch terms, proving O(M^{-1}) error rates for optimal sketches under mild moment conditions.
